Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle
was struck while turning left. Presenting complaints consisted of neck pain,
stiffness, and restricted cervical range of motion, with headaches reported on the day
of the incident. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the
impact and with the cervical strain diagnosed. Imaging and physical examination
findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of cervical strain. No prior injury or
treatment to the cervical spine has been identified in the available history.
Conservative management was provided over five visits, consisting of manual therapy,
targeted stretching, and a home exercise program. Recovery was somewhat slower than
typically expected for this injury, though progress was steady throughout care.
Billing records reflect one charge per service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate
entries. At the most recent visit, the patient reported partial improvement and was
advised to continue the home program and return if symptoms worsen.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
